3A.name: 3A · Axel
3A.note: Triple Axel. Take-off from the left forward outside edge, the only forward take-off. 3½ turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4T.name: 4T · Toe loop
4T.note: Quadruple toe loop. Take-off from the right back outside edge with a left toe pick. 4 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3T.name: 3T · Toe loop
3T.note: Triple toe loop. Take-off from the right back outside edge with a left toe pick. 3 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4S.name: 4S · Salchow
4S.note: Quadruple Salchow. Take-off from the left back inside edge, free leg sweeping round, no toe pick. 4 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

1Eu.name: 1Eu · Euler
1Eu.note: Euler. One turn from the right back outside edge, landing on the left back inside edge. In competition it appears only inside combinations, to link two jumps. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3F.name: 3F · Flip
3F.note: Triple flip. Take-off from the left back inside edge with a right toe pick. 3 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3Lz.name: 3Lz · Lutz
3Lz.note: Triple Lutz. Take-off from the left back outside edge with a right toe pick. 3 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

2T.name: 2T · Toe loop
2T.note: Double toe loop. Take-off from the right back outside edge with a left toe pick. 2 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3Lo.name: 3Lo · Loop
3Lo.note: Triple loop. Take-off from the right back outside edge with both feet close, no toe pick. 3 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3S.name: 3S · Salchow
3S.note: Triple Salchow. Take-off from the left back inside edge, free leg sweeping round, no toe pick. 3 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4F.name: 4F · Flip
4F.note: Quadruple flip. Take-off from the left back inside edge with a right toe pick. 4 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4Lz.name: 4Lz · Lutz
4Lz.note: Quadruple Lutz. Take-off from the left back outside edge with a right toe pick. 4 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4Lo.name: 4Lo · Loop
4Lo.note: Quadruple loop. Take-off from the right back outside edge with both feet close, no toe pick. 4 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

1F.name: 1F · Flip
1F.note: Single flip. Take-off from the left back inside edge with a right toe pick. 1 turn in an open air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

2S.name: 2S · Salchow
2S.note: Double Salchow. Take-off from the left back inside edge, free leg sweeping round, no toe pick. 2 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

1S.name: 1S · Salchow
1S.note: Single Salchow. Take-off from the left back inside edge, free leg sweeping round, no toe pick. 1 turn in an open air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

2A.name: 2A · Axel
2A.note: Double Axel. Take-off from the left forward outside edge, the only forward take-off. 2½ turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Path and timing adapted from FS-Jump3D sample C07 by Ryota Takeda and colleagues, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; its take-off marker is late, so the turn readout undercounts this jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

2F.name: 2F · Flip
2F.note: Double flip. Take-off from the left back inside edge with a right toe pick. 2 turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4A.name: 4A · Standard quadruple Axel
4A.note: Quadruple Axel. Take-off from the left forward outside edge, the only forward take-off. 4½ turns in a tight air position, then a one-foot landing on the right back outside edge with the free leg extended. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4T+3T.name: 4T+3T · Quadruple toe loop + triple toe loop
4T+3T.note: Two jumps with no step between them: Quadruple toe loop (left toe pick) → triple toe loop (left toe pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3A+2T.name: 3A+2T · Triple Axel + double toe loop
3A+2T.note: Two jumps with no step between them: Triple Axel (forward take-off) → double toe loop (left toe pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3Lz+3T.name: 3Lz+3T · Triple Lutz + triple toe loop
3Lz+3T.note: Two jumps with no step between them: Triple Lutz (right toe pick) → triple toe loop (left toe pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3A+1Eu+3S.name: 3A+1Eu+3S · Triple Axel + Euler + triple Salchow
3A+1Eu+3S.note: Three jumps with no step between them: Triple Axel (forward take-off) → Euler (one turn, lands on the left back inside edge) → triple Salchow (left back inside edge). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3F+3T.name: 3F+3T · Triple Flip + triple toe loop

3Lz+3Lo.note: Two jumps with no step between them: Triple Lutz (right toe pick) → triple loop (right back outside edge, no pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3A+1Eu+1F.note: Three jumps with no step between them: Triple Axel (forward take-off) → Euler (one turn, lands on the left back inside edge) → single flip (right toe pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3F+2T.name: 3F+2T · Triple Flip + double toe loop
3F+2T.note: Two jumps with no step between them: Triple flip (right toe pick) → double toe loop (left toe pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3F+3Lo.note: Two jumps with no step between them: Triple flip (right toe pick) → triple loop (right back outside edge, no pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

3Lz+2T.note: Two jumps with no step between them: Triple Lutz (right toe pick) → double toe loop (left toe pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4F+3T.name: 4F+3T · Quadruple Flip + triple toe loop
4F+3T.note: Two jumps with no step between them: Quadruple flip (right toe pick) → triple toe loop (left toe pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4Lo+1Eu+3S.name: 4Lo+1Eu+3S · Quadruple loop + Euler + triple Salchow
4Lo+1Eu+3S.note: Three jumps with no step between them: Quadruple loop (right back outside edge, no pick) → Euler (one turn, lands on the left back inside edge) → triple Salchow (left back inside edge). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4S+2T.name: 4S+2T · Quadruple Salchow + double toe loop
4S+2T.note: Two jumps with no step between them: Quadruple Salchow (left back inside edge) → double toe loop (left toe pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4S+3T.name: 4S+3T · Quadruple Salchow + triple toe loop
4S+3T.note: Two jumps with no step between them: Quadruple Salchow (left back inside edge) → triple toe loop (left toe pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4T+1Eu+1F.note: Three jumps with no step between them: Quadruple toe loop (left toe pick) → Euler (one turn, lands on the left back inside edge) → single flip (right toe pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

CCoSp.name: CCoSp · Change-foot combination spin
CCoSp.note: Change-foot combination spin. Camel, sit and upright positions on the first foot, then sit and upright on the other foot. The spin speeds up as the arms pull in. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

CSSp.name: CSSp · Change-foot sit spin
CSSp.note: Change-foot sit spin. Sit position on one foot (skating knee bent, free leg extended forward), a change of foot, then the sit position again. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

FCSp.name: FCSp · Flying camel spin
FCSp.note: Flying camel spin. A jump entry lands in the camel position: body and free leg in one horizontal line. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

FCCoSp.name: FCCoSp · Flying change-foot combination spin
FCCoSp.note: Flying change-foot combination spin. A jump entry leads into camel, sit and upright positions, a change of foot, then sit and upright again. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

CCSp.name: CCSp · Change-foot camel spin
CCSp.note: Change-foot camel spin. Camel position (body and free leg in one horizontal line) on one foot, a change of foot, then camel again. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

FSSp.name: FSSp · Flying sit spin
FSSp.note: Flying sit spin. A jump entry lands directly in the sit position: skating knee bent, free leg extended forward. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

FCSSp.name: FCSSp · Flying change-foot sit spin
FCSSp.note: Flying change-foot sit spin. A jump entry lands in the sit position, followed by a change of foot and the sit position again. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

StSq.name: StSq · Step sequence
StSq.note: Step sequence. Turns and steps across the ice; this sample shows a three-turn, a twizzle, a bracket and toe steps. Competition sequences are longer and set to the music. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

ChSq.name: ChSq · Choreographic sequence
ChSq.note: Choreographic sequence. Free movement with a fixed base value; this sample shows a spiral, a spread eagle and a lunge. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.

4Lz+3T.name: 4Lz+3T · Quadruple Lutz + triple toe loop
4Lz+3T.note: Two jumps with no step between them: Quadruple Lutz (right toe pick) → triple toe loop (left toe pick). Each landing edge is the take-off edge of the next jump. Illustrative / simulated; not Beijing 2022 motion capture.
